name: How long does it typically take to build a turnkey tiny home?
description: Typically, a turnkey tiny home build takes 3 to 6 months from initial consultation to move-in, depending on design and permitting.

mainEntity.name: How long does it typically take to build a turnkey tiny home?

acceptedAnswer.text: The timeline for a turnkey tiny home build can vary based on design complexity, permitting processes, and material availability. On average, from the initial consultation to move-in ready completion, a project can take anywhere from 3 to 6 months. This includes time for design finalization, obtaining necessary permits, site preparation, construction, and final inspections. Zen Tiny Homes provides a detailed timeline estimate after the initial design phase.
acceptedAnswer.description: Typically, a turnkey tiny home build takes 3 to 6 months from initial consultation to move-in, depending on design and permitting.
